parent_objective: design a causal history gate after corrected profile comparisons fail to prove memory necessity
blocked_by: Profile comparisons cannot prove self-identification because current-tiled and reset controls explain key trends
supersedes: running more broad profile pilots as the next default step
invalidates: using aggregate profile ranking as memory-causality evidence

public_gates: M1215 may design causal history gates only
M1215 must target matched-current observations with different histories or hidden dynamics
M1215 must pre-register normal reset delayed wrong-history and current-tiled controls
M1215 must not use private holdout
M1215 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use oracle actor inputs
do not call aggregate ranking a causal history gate

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a gate that can directly test whether policy behavior causally depends on command-response history
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design relies on hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if the design only compares aggregate profile returns
stop if the design lacks reset delayed or wrong-history controls
stop if current observations are not matched or ambiguity is not measured
fallback_plan: route to ambiguity-corpus export if matched-current samples are missing
route to task/curriculum repair if no ambiguity can be found
route to implementation if existing tools can support the gate
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1214 promotes the branch from aggregate profile comparison to causal history evidence

admission_evidence: M1214 synthesizes corrected profile evidence and blocks aggregate profile rankings as self-ID proof
M1214 preserves stable negative L2/current-tiled evidence
M1214 routes to matched-current causal history gates as the higher-leverage next branch
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: gate objective and controls are fixed
success and failure thresholds are pre-registered
next implementation or audit milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1215 must include current-tiled and current-response controls because profile aggregates showed current-frame substitution risk.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: The design must test causal history dependence rather than profile capacity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no matched-current causal degradation exists, record that as negative evidence and route to task/curriculum redesign.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A matched-current causal history gate can more directly test self-identification than aggregate profile comparison.
success_criteria: gate inputs and interventions are defined
success and failure thresholds are pre-registered
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next implementation or audit milestone is selected
failure_criteria: gate uses hidden or oracle actor inputs
self-identification is claimed from profile aggregates

commands.name: design_causal_history_gate
commands.command: write matched-current causal history gate design without training

decision_rule: M1215 passes if it pre-registers a causal history gate without training or claim expansion.
